items.title: Show HN: Gitbet – A free sourcetree style Git client for Linux
items.contentSnippet:
I used Sourcetree for about 7 years on macOS and Windows. When I switched to Linux, I found it isn’t available, and none of the alternatives had the layout and UX I liked.
I kept it small on purpose, I don't plan to add many features. Builds for Linux, mac os, and windows. Happy to hear some feedback and share if it's useful to other developers too.

It started Windows only, but I recently converted over to Linux, so I've been ironing out the kinks in the last week. You can install it via apt or rpm, or .exe or .msi on Windows.
Many more features to come, including native agent support and more preview features (images, PDF, document formats). Claude works pretty well in it, but I've not tried many other agents yet.

items.title: Show HN: ScrivenSpell
items.contentSnippet:
ScrivenSpell is a word game with RPG elements. If you like Scrabble, you might like this.
This game is inspired by Up Spell, an old iOS game. That game was a lot of fun but unfortunately no longer fits the screen shapes of recent devices.
It also lacked staying power, at least for me, which is why I experimented with RPG elements in ScrivenSpell. With monsters and Quote Quest the player has a series of goals and can work toward 100% completion.
